text: Lianshan is also home to a wealth of intangible cultural heritage, including the Fire Lion Dance (舞火狮), Yao Tambourine Dance (瑶族小长鼓舞), Qianghuapao Bamboo Ball Game (抢花炮), Zhuang Bayin (八音) and Yao Bayin—distinctive forms of traditional eight-tone music.
